scope: Historical source identity and inherited Apache-2.0 attribution of NVIDIA-supplied PNanoVDB; no runtime acceptance claim

openvdb.copyright: Copyright Contributors to the OpenVDB Project

comparison.method: Compare bytes starting at the first /*! author header after replacing CRLF with LF. NVIDIA copy lacks the preceding OpenVDB copyright and SPDX lines; no implementation bytes ignored.

distributionNote: Retain the OpenVDB copyright, Apache-2.0 license, author notice and exact dependency source with source/binary packages. Exclusion of the emitter NanoVDB pipeline does not exclude all PNanoVDB-dependent host code.
